vector_memory.semantic_summary: The Transform class manages the spatial properties (position, rotation, scale) of an entity within a 3D scene graph. It calculates the final world-space transformation matrix lazily, relying on parent transformations for hierarchical consistency. It provides both local and world-space accessors, supporting setters that automatically recalculate local values based on parent context. The component integrates serialization via JsonSerializable and handles matrix updates recursively.
